narrationStatus: The user requested a real human narrator. New original narrative captions have a complete recording script but no recording yet. Natural synthetic narration was offered; consent is not assumed. Historical voices are genuine recordings.
openingContext: The two opening lines are a poetic prologue requested by the author. They are not a scientific claim that physics has established a state of absolute nothingness before the Big Bang.
scientificContext: Ancient cosmos and Earth are existing NASA artist/scientific visualizations; modern Earth and nightlights are observation-derived. Nightlights symbolize humanity; no prehistoric camera footage is claimed. The final Curiosity closeup is existing NASA CGI, joined to a reversed orbital-image tour and a separate solar-system camera. It is not one physically continuous camera journey. Solar distances/planet sizes are illustrative.
historicalContext: V1 was a cruise missile, not a ballistic space rocket. The V1 archive is German wartime footage from 1944.
The V2 launch film depicts a captured German V2 at White Sands, United States, 10 May 1946, not a 1944 German launch.
Wernher von Braun was a Nazi Party and SS member. V2 production used forced labor. NASA biography and history references document this context.
Sputnik is an original flight spare filmed in 2017; its actual satellite signal is a separate NASA archive recording.
Challenger was lost on 28 January 1986; Columbia on 1 February 2003. Fourteen crew members died. Neither accident was the last Shuttle mission, STS-135 in 2011.
Hubble imagery is actual 1990 deployment, not CGI. Zarya and Unity assembly is actual 1998 camera footage. Columbus installation is actual 2008 ESA camera footage.

The SpaceX failure insert is an identified CC0 photograph of the approach before the failed CRS-6 recovery on 14 April 2015. It is not an explosion movie. No verified reusable failure movie was obtained.
The Falcon Heavy launch is STP-2 in 2019; the daylight Falcon 9 landing is Sentinel-6 in 2020. These are different missions, not the first successful landing and not a Starship tower catch.
Curiosity is not described as retired or abandoned. The hardware catalogue remains empty pending Hugo’s validated research.
score: Helios by Scott Buckley, CC-BY 4.0. Edited, normalized, and mixed beneath original archives. The quiet interlude is repeated with a crossfade to fit the documentary; it is not public-domain music.
